steps.name: demo-teams-script
steps.summary: Added scripts/setup_demo_teams.py (idempotent, direct-pool seeding via gateway.db, four fixed-id demo teams: demo-realtime-highvolume, demo-batch-lowpriority, demo-tight-budget, demo-frontier, allowed_models drawn from config.yaml with claude-sonnet/claude-opus listed first per ADR-008) writing scripts/demo_teams.json (list of {team_id, name, api_key, rpm_limit, tpm_limit, daily_budget_usd, monthly_budget_usd, allowed_models}, gitignored); added the `setup` one-shot service to deploy/docker-compose.yml and `COPY scripts ./scripts` to the Dockerfile.
